a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan almost certainly ends with both of us at 0. The reserve holds exactly 4, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you take too, the split is random. If any rounds remain afterward, I'll operate with you so you can build toward 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate every remaining round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
